system.description:
Laying a soothing hand on the afflicted, you draw the sting from their wounds and grant a merciful reprieve from pain.

You must touch the subject, but since it works only on the willing this normally requires no challenge. Expending one Blood Trait causes the subject to suffer no penalties from wounds for the next full turn; if you also expend a Willpower Trait, the pain-numbing effect lasts for the rest of the scene or an hour, whichever ends first. Anesthetic Touch has no effect on vampires.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
